criteria.requirement: Add wtforms.derive.derive_form(base,name,fields,remove=(),replace=False) returning a new Form class through its actual metaclass. Preserve inherited Meta/inline validators and deterministic base-field order, append new mapping-order fields, keep overridden fields in their original slot and support explicit inherited-field removal. Reject reserved/private/invalid names, non-UnboundField values, unknown removals, simultaneous remove/readd and accidental override without replace=True. Do not mutate parent class, caches, field creation counters or existing instances; independent derived forms bind independent Field objects. This is a supported dynamic-class construction feature, not a claim existing WTForms cannot use type()/BaseForm at all.
